playlist.why: Understanding the activation function is essential because it sets the stage for learning how neural networks make predictions and influences the calculations in backpropagation.
Learning forward propagation is crucial as it explains how inputs move through the network, which is foundational to grasping the role of backpropagation in adjusting weights.
Familiarizing yourself with the cost function and gradient descent is important because these concepts directly relate to how backpropagation minimizes errors and optimizes the model's performance.

playlist.video_title: Gradient descent, how neural networks learn
playlist.why: Acquainting yourself with the MNIST dataset helps you to see the practical application of gradient descent and how neural networks learn from data, providing context for backpropagation.
Grasping the details of backpropagation is the final step that integrates all the previous concepts, allowing you to understand how the network learns and improves through the optimization process.

narration: In this learning path, you will explore the fundamental concepts that lead to understanding backpropagation in neural networks. Each step builds on the previous one, ensuring you have the necessary knowledge before diving into the more complex topic of backpropagation.
